from typing import TYPE_CHECKING as CHECK
import typing as types

class Base:
    def raises(self):
        """To be implemented by the derived class."""
        raise NotImplementedError("override")
    def empty(self): pass
    def documented(self):
        """An interface declaration."""
    def ellipsis(self): ...
    def effect(self):
        print("observable")
        raise NotImplementedError
    def unoverridden(self): pass

class Middle(Base): pass
class Concrete(Middle):
    def raises(self): return 1
    def empty(self): return 2
    def documented(self): return 3
    def ellipsis(self): return 4
    def effect(self): return 5

class RuntimeMixin:
    if CHECK:
        def declared(self): ...
    if types.TYPE_CHECKING and True:
        def second(self): ...
    else:
        def runtime(self): return 6
    def caller(self):
        self.declared()
        self.second()
        self.runtime()

class RuntimeImplementation:
    def declared(self): return 7

class Combined(RuntimeMixin, RuntimeImplementation): pass

def use(x):
    x.raises()
    x.empty()
    x.documented()
    x.ellipsis()
    x.effect()
    x.unoverridden()
